chunks: A number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Khalid, from Uthman ibn Isa, from Sama'a ibn Mihran, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
'The woman is buried up to her waist, then the Imam pelts, then the people pelt with small stones.'

key_terms.أَحْجَار صِغَار: small stones (the specific size prescribed for the implements of rajm)
key_terms.الْإِمَامُ: the Imam (the legitimate Islamic authority who initiates the punishment)
key_terms.تُدْفَنُ: is buried (in the ground, as a preparatory step for the rajm punishment)
key_terms.وَسَط: middle/waist (the midpoint of the body, specifying depth of burial)
key_terms.يَرْمِي: pelts/throws stones (the act of stoning as execution)

ai.seo_question: What is the procedure for stoning a woman according to Imam al-Sadiq in Al-Kafi?
ai.summary: This hadith from Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) describes the juridical procedure for carrying out the hadd punishment of stoning (rajm) for a woman convicted of a capital offense. The narration specifies that the woman is to be buried in the ground up to her waist before the stoning begins, and that the Imam himself initiates the stoning before the general populace follows. The use of small stones is also prescribed. This ruling reflects classical Shia fiqh, where the role of the Imam or his representative is essential in executing hudud penalties.
